source: 712 “Accusation”
target: 712 “Accusatio”

source: Lumian stood beside Moran Avigny’s villa, wearing a wide-brimmed round hat and a black tweed coat.
target: Lumian iuxta villam Moran Avigny stetit, indutus pileo rotundo lato atque cappa nigra tweedi.

source: He gazed at the garden, its few withered leaves rustling in the breeze, and said to Franca, “Keep your distance later.”
target: Hortum contemplatus est, quo pauca folia exsiccata in aura susurrabant, et Francae dixerat: “Custodi distantiam tuam postea!”

source: As he spoke, Lumian’s eyes turned silver-black once more, allowing him to observe the fate tributaries corresponding to Franca’s future.
target: Dum loquebatur, oculi Lumiani iterum in argentum–nigrum converterunt, permittens eum videre rivulos fati qui ad futurum Francae pertinebant.

source: The tributary tainted with a faint black color was unrelated to their upcoming infiltration.
target: Rivulus fati, leviter nigro tinctus, ad eorum venturam incursationem non pertinuit.

source: Given the current circumstances, sneaking into Moran Avigny’s villa and leaving a Mirror Mark on the full-body mirror in his study didn’t seem to pose a high risk of death.
target: Ex condicionibus praesentibus, furtim in villam Moran Avigny intrare et signum speculi in speculo totius corporis in studiō relinquere non videbatur altum periculum mortis afferre.

source: However, Lumian knew better than to let his guard down.
target: At Lumian melius sciebat neque custodiam suam demittere.

source: After using the Eye of Calamity several times, he understood that a single black fate tributary didn’t necessarily mean there was only one hidden death calamity lurking.
target: Postquam Oculum Calamitatis aliquoties usus est, intellexit unum solum rivulum fati nigro tinctum non necessario significare unam tantum occultam calamitatem mortis latere.

source: According to Franca, numerous death calamities were concealed further along the fate tributary, too blurry for Lumian to discern or differentiate.
target: Secundum Francam, multas calamitates mortis in ulteriori cursu fati absconditae erant, nimis obscurae ut Lumian eas discerneret aut distingueret.

source: In other words, even though there was presently just one faintly black-tainted fate tributary connected to their infiltration of Moran Avigny’s villa, when Franca made her decision and tried to enter, transforming the harmless fate tributary into the main path, a black tributary symbolizing a deadly calamity might still emerge.
target: Aliter dicendum est: quamquam nunc solum unus rivulus fati, leviter nigro tinctus, cum incursione in villam Moran Avigny coniunctus erat, cum Franca consilium ceperit et intrare conata sit, transformans illud innocuum rivulum fati in viam principalem, rivulus niger calamitatem mortiferam significare potuit.

source: Lumian’s profound realization about this was: The fate of the future was variable and ever-evolving.
target: Profunda huius rei intellēctio Lumiani fuit: fatum futuri variabile et semper mutabile erat.

source: Of course, certain aspects were destined to remain constant.
target: Certe, quaedam elementa constantia manere destinata erant.

source: For instance, death was the inevitable fate awaiting most humans.
target: Exempli gratia, mors erat fatum inevitabile plerisque hominibus exspectans.

source: “No need to worry, I’m not new to this,” Franca assured him, confident in her infiltration skills.
target: “Noli solliciti esse, haec mihi nota sunt,” Franca eum asseruit, fidens in artibus ingressūs suis.

source: Assassin 101: Infiltration!
target: Sicarius 101: Ingressus!

source: Without another word, Lumian activated the mark and morphed into a shadow creature, melding into the shadows cast by the garden’s plants.
target: Nullo alio verbo, Lumian signum activavit et in creaturam umbrarum se mutavit, miscendo cum umbris a plantis horti proiectorum.

source: Franca stepped forward and disappeared into the wind-stirred shadows.
target: Franca processit et in umbras ventō concitatas evanuit.

source: The pair swiftly and stealthily made their way to the side of the villa.
target: Par duo celeriter et furtim ad latus villae pervenerunt.

source: At the same time, Moran Avigny was attending a ministerial meeting.
target: Eodem tempore, Moran Avigny conventum ministralem frequentabat.

source: His wife had gone to an art salon with her lady’s maid, leaving only a handful of valets, maids, gardeners, and chefs in the villa.
target: Uxor eius cum ancilla artis salone ivit, relinquens in villa paucos tantum servos, ancillas, hortulanos, et coquos.

source: The Avigny family didn’t live there.
target: Familia Avigny ibi non habitabat.

source: Only the immediate family of the Minister of Industry was permitted to reside in the government-provided villa long-term.
target: Solum familia inmediata Ministri Industria in villa a re publica provisa diuturno tempore manere licuit.

source: Moran Avigny’s three children had either already married and moved out or were attending university in the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative.
target: Tres liberi Moran Avigny vel iam coniugati exierant, vel in universitate in Quartiere Cathédralis Commemorativae studebant.

source: They only returned home on weekends.
target: Solum in diebus finium hebdomadis domum redibant.

source: For Lumian and Franca, this was when the target location’s security was at its most vulnerable.
target: Pro Lumiano et Franca, hoc tempus erat quo securitas loci petiti maxime vulnerabilis videbatur.

source: After all, Moran Avigny was the VIP.
target: Nam Moran Avigny erat persona praecipua.

source: The covert protection detail would undoubtedly stick close to him.
target: Praesidium occultum sine dubio ei adhaerebit.

source: Lumian emerged from the shadows in the corner and instructed Franca,
target: Lumian ex umbris in angulo emersit et Francae imperavit:

source: “Wait here and keep an eye out for any trouble.”
target: “Hic mane et intuere, ne aliqua perturbatio eveniat.”

source: “Got it!” Franca agreed without protest.
target: “Intellectum!” Franca sine mora assensuit.

source: Lumian concentrated on the Demoness of Pleasure’s fate tributary for a few moments before shifting back into a shadow creature and silently slipping into Moran Avigny’s villa.
target: Lumian paucis momentis in rivulo fati Daemonissae Voluptatis intentavit, deinde in formam umbrarum iterum se convertit et silentio in villam Moran Avigny se infiltravit.

source: He couldn’t view his own future fate, even with the aid of a mirror.
target: Suam futuram fatum, etiam auxilio speculi, videre non poterat.

source: His only option was to infer his fate by watching his companions.
target: Unica eius consilium erat fatum suum ex sociis intuendis conicere.

source: Franca concealed herself in the shadows and patiently waited.
target: Franca se in umbris celavit et patienter exspectavit.

source: It wasn’t long before Lumian reached Moran Avigny’s study, navigating it as if it were his own home.
target: Non multum temporis elapsum est, cum Lumian ad studiō Moran Avigny perveniret, eum quasi domum suam percurrens.

source: He had witnessed Moran Avigny use the full-body mirror there to access the mirror world on multiple occasions.
target: Vidit quotiens Moran Avigny speculum totius corporis ibi aditum in mundum specularum obtinuisse.

source: As for his familiarity with the layout, that was thanks to the detailed security map provided by 007.
target: Ad notitiam dispositionis suae, hoc debitum erat ad mappam securitatis subtiliter explicatam a 007 datam.

source: The winter sunlight around 4 p.m. was dim.
target: Lumen hyemale circa horam quartam post meridiem tenue fulgebat.

source: The study was a mix of light and darkness, evoking a strong sense of dusk.
target: Studium erat mixtura lucis et obscuritatis, crepusculum vehementer evocans.

source: The silence had long been a constant melody in this space.
target: Silentium diu in hoc loco constans melos fuit.

source: Lumian meticulously searched the study from within the shadows but found no traps or hidden individuals.
target: Lumian diligenter in studiō ex umbris perquisivit, sed neque insidias neque homines occultos invenit.

source: Only then did he revert to his human form, breaking free from the shadows and reappearing in front of the full-body mirror.
target: Tunc ad formam humanam rediit, ex umbris evadens atque coram speculo totius corporis iterum apparuit.

source: As the black mark activated, Lumian reached out his right palm and pressed it against the cold, hard glass.
target: Cum notam nigrum activatum esset, Lumian dextrum manum extulit et contra vitrum frigidum et durum appulit.

source: A blood-colored handprint instantly materialized, reversed from Lumian’s right palm as if it belonged to someone else.
target: Immediāte impressio manuum sanguine colorata exstiterunt, reflexa ex manu dextro Lumiani, quasi alicuius alterius esse videbatur.

source: The inverted, sinister blood-colored palm print quickly faded, blending into the mirror and vanishing.
target: Impressio palmae inversa, sinistra sanguine colorata, celeriter evanuit, in speculo conflata atque dissipata.

source: Just as Lumian was about to pull his right palm back and leave, a hand abruptly extended from the full-body mirror and seized his wrist.
target: Iam, cum Lumian dextram manum revocare atque discedere pararet, manus subito ex speculo totius corporis protensa eius carpus apprehendit.

source: The hand was a healthy white, with long, powerful fingers.
target: Manus alba et sana erat, digitis longis atque validis.

source: It yanked with tremendous force, catching Lumian off guard and sending him crashing into the glass mirror.
target: Illā vehementer attrahente, Lumian inopinate cepit atque in vitrum speculum impellit.

source: At some point, the mirror had turned ethereal, shedding its corporeal form.
target: Aliquando, speculum in aetherinum factum est, formam corporis abiciens.

source: Lumian’s vision went dark before illuminating to reveal numerous dark passageways resembling a spiderweb.
target: Visio Lumiani obscurata est, deinde lucem cepit ut multas viae tenebrosae, telam araneam similes, revelaret.

source: In the area corresponding to the current mirror, an ordinary-looking man stood at the edge.
target: In regione speculo hodierno pertinenti, vir simplex in margine stabat.

source: He raised his brass revolver, aimed it at Lumian, and pulled the trigger.
target: Ille revolver aereum extulit, in Lumian intendens, et ictum misit.

source: Clad in a dark tweed suit and a half top hat, with a glass-like cufflink fastened to his sleeve, he wore a faint smile, as if mocking Lumian for not anticipating the possibility of Moran Avigny’s bodyguard hiding in the mirror.
target: Indutus habitu nigro-tweedi et semi pileo, cum fibula vitrea ad manica ligata, levem risum gerebat, quasi irridebat Lumian quod non praevidisset custodem Moran Avigny in speculo latitantem.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: A bullet gleaming with ghostly green light shot towards Lumian.
target: Globulus, luce viridi quasi phantasmatico splendens, in Lumian volavit.

source: Lumian’s figure abruptly vanished.
target: Figura Lumiani subito evanuit.

source: The bullet struck the afterimage he left behind and flew into one of the dark, empty tunnels.
target: Globulus postumbram quam reliquerat percussit et in unum ex cuniculis tenebrosis et desertis volavit.

source: In the next instant, Lumian swiftly materialized behind the ambusher and, without hesitation, harrumphed.
target: In proximo momento, Lumian celeriter post impostorem apparuit et, sine mora, fremivit.

source: Two beams of white light shot out from his nose and struck the ambusher.
target: Duo radii lucis albae ex naso eius emiserunt et impostorem percusserunt.

source: The ambusher’s eyes snapped shut, and he crumpled to the ground.
target: Oculi impostoris subito claudebantur, et ille in terram corruit.

source: Midway through, his eyes darted around and he snapped out of his daze.
target: Interea, oculi eius circumspicuerunt, et ille ex stupore evasit.

source: Thud! He crashed to the ground, transforming his body into a shadow.
target: Thud! Terram percussus est, corpus suum in umbram transformans.

source: The shadows disintegrated and spread in all directions, entering various dark tunnels.
target: Umbrae dissolutae sunt et in omnes partes disseminatae, ingredientes diversos cuniculos tenebrosos.

source: Immediately after, the ambusher stealthily materialized in an empty passageway, his form shrouded in faint white fog.
target: Statim post, impostor furtim in via vacua apparuit, forma eius in nebula alba tenue involuta.

source: Lumian’s figure was reflected in his misty eyes.
target: Figura Lumiani in oculis eius nebulosis reflexa est.

source: Before Lumian could sense it and turn to look, the ambusher spoke in a strange language that could stir the forces of nature, “You’re guilty!”
target: Antequam Lumian id percipere et se convertere potuisset, impostor in lingua insolita, quae vires naturae excitare posset, locutus est: “Tu es reus!”

source: Lumian had never encountered this language, but he clearly understood its meaning.
target: Numquam hanc linguam audiverat, sed sensum eius plane intellexit.

source: His body suddenly froze, as if under an invisible restriction.
target: Corpus eius subito immobilis factum est, quasi sub vinculo invisibili.

source: The ambusher opened his mouth again.
target: Impostor iterum os aperuit.

source: “You blasphemer!”
target: “Tu sacrilegus es!”

source: Suddenly, the entire mirror world froze, and the dark, ethereal passageways transformed into tiny amber insects.
target: Subito, totus mundus specularis immobilis factus est, et viae tenebrosae ac aetheriae in parvos insectos, colore ambri, transformatae sunt.

source: Once again, Lumian heard a terrifying voice that seemed to come from an infinite distance.
target: Iterum, Lumian vocem terribilem audivit, quae ex infiniti distantia venire videbatur.

source: Vaguely, he “saw” three figures.
target: Vagiter tres figuras conspexit.

source: The three figures sat cross-legged, one facing left, one looking straight ahead, and the other looking right.
target: Tres figurae in genu sessae erant: una ad sinistram versa, una recta in ante, et altera ad dexteram spectans.

source: Their hands were in different postures.
target: Manus eorum in diversis positionibus erant.

source: One was heavy, one real, and one ethereal.
target: Una grave erat, una realis, et una aetheria.

source: They were in three different states, constantly moving, changing, and interchanging around a silver circle.
target: In tribus diversis statibus versabantur, constanter moventes, mutantes et inter se circa circulum argenteum intermutantes.

source: A majestic and resounding voice reverberated, causing Lumian’s mind to buzz as he lost consciousness.
target: Vox magnificā et resonāns reverberavit, faciens ut mens Lumiani fremitare inciperet, donec conscientiam amisit.

source: Amidst the blurry, vivid pain, the dazed Lumian felt a familiar burning sensation on his left chest.
target: Inter dolorem nebulosum et vividum, Lumian attonitus sensum ardoris notum in pecto sinistro sensit.

source: His right palm alternated between burning and freezing.
target: Palma dextra eius inter ardorem et frigorem alternabat.

source: Gradually, he regained consciousness.
target: Gradatim conscientiam recuperavit.

source: In a dark tunnel that had solidified, the ambusher witnessed silver-black warts erupting from Lumian’s body, emitting sinister patterns that resembled viscous liquid.
target: In cuniculo tenebroso, solidato, impostor vidit verrucas argentum–nigrae ex corpore Lumiani erumpere, figuras sinistras exhibentes quae liquorem viscosum repraesentabant.

source: At some point, a strange, cold wind swept through the surroundings.
target: Aliquando, ventus mirus ac frigidus per loca circumstantia disseminatus est.

source: Darkness squirmed in the depths of the different tunnels, as if a monster was about to crawl out.
target: Tenebrae in profundis diversorum cuniculorum contorquebantur, quasi monstrum emergere pararetur.

source: The ambusher’s body stiffened, becoming increasingly sluggish, with a faint white fog barely discernible within.
target: Corpus impostoris rigidum factum est, magis magisque inertum, cum nebula alba tenue intra se fere percepta.

source: After an unknown period of time, the man finally survived the most dangerous moment.
target: Post spatium ignotum, vir tandem ex momento periculo maximo superfuit.

source: He felt his body again and regained his vision and hearing.
target: Corpus suum iterum sensit atque visionem ac auditum recuperavit.

source: As Lumian’s warts and patterns faded, the ambusher instinctively felt a lingering fear.
target: Dum verrucae et figurae Lumiani evanuebant, impostor instanter metu residuali affectus est.

source: How did he commit blasphemy?
target: Quomodo sacrilegium commisit?

source: Which deity did he blaspheme against?
target: Contra quam deitatem sacrilegium commisit?

source: Why didn’t he lose control?
target: Cur imperium sui non amisit?

source: I’ve never encountered such a situation before!
target: Numquam antea talem rem expertus sum!

source: The Beyonder powers possessed by the ambusher allowed him to discern the target’s crimes and “accuse” him of various charges.
target: Potentiae Beyonder, quas impostor habebat, ei permisērunt crimina obiecta discerere et eum variis delictis accusare.

source: The damage and effects of different crimes were completely different, and the accuser couldn’t predict them beforehand.
target: Damna et effectus variorum delictorum omnino diversi erant, et accusator ea praevidere non poterat.

source: They could only make a guess based on their experience from previous “cases.”
target: Soli coniecturam facere poterant, ex experientiis priorum casuum innixi.

source: This was the first time the ambusher had encountered a situation where he nearly succumbed to the overflowing influence of the deity after the sinner was punished by a deity for blasphemy!
target: Hoc primum fuit, quo impostor experiebatur rem in qua fere cecidisset sub effusa deitatis influentia, postquam peccator a deitate pro sacrilegio poenam accepisset!

source: Fortunately, he recovered before the target.
target: Fortunate, se ante obiectum recuperavit.

source: The ambusher raised the brass revolver once more and aimed it at Lumian, who was hunched over in pain.
target: Impostor revolver aereum iterum extulit et in Lumian destinavit, qui dolore incurvatus stabat.

source: Just as he pulled the trigger, Lumian’s head snapped up, his expression contorted with ferocity.
target: Iam dum iaculabat, caput Lumiani subito erexit et vultus ferocitate contorsus est.

source: Bang!
target: Bang!

source: A bullet shimmering with starlight shot out from the muzzle, locked onto the target’s body.
target: Globulus, luce stellae micans, e rostro exiit, corpus obiectum destinans.

source: Almost simultaneously, Lumian’s shadow came to life and flipped upward.
target: Paene simul, umbra Lumiani vivificata est et surrexit.

source: Crack!
target: Crack!

source: The black shadow shattered like a mirror. Along with the starlight, it caved in and was obliterated.
target: Umbra nigra quasi speculum confracta est; una cum luce stellari cecidit et evanuit.

source: After briefly disappearing, Lumian materialized behind the ambusher and harrumphed once more.
target: Postquam breviter evanuit, Lumian post impostorem emersit et iterum fremivit.

source: He had used Shadow Animation in time, and the shadow had triggered Franca’s Mirror Substitution!
target: Tempestive, umbrae animatio usus erat, et umbra substitutionem speculi Francae excitaverat!

source: This was why Lumian had Franca infiltrate the villa and stay outside. Relying on Mirror Substitution required maintaining a certain distance.
target: Hinc cur Lumian Francam ad villam incursare et extra manere decreverit; fidere in substitutione speculi postulabat ut certa distantia servaretur.

source: It turned out his shadow could also share Mirror Substitution!
target: Invenitur quod umbra eius etiam substitutionem speculi participare possit!

source: Two beams of white light shot out, causing the ambusher to close his eyes again.
target: Duo radii lucis albae exierunt, facientes ut impostor oculos iterum claudere coegeretur.

source: This time, Lumian didn’t give the enemy a chance to quickly wake up. He extended his right foot and blocked the enemy, preventing him from falling.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian hosti occasionem celeriter evigilandi non dedit. Dextrum pedem extendit et hostem obstruxit, ne caderet.

source: Simultaneously, he drew his revolver and pressed it against the target’s forehead.
target: Simul, revolver suum extraxit et in fronte obiecti appoinevit.

source: The ambusher’s eyes darted around, and he awoke to the terrifying pressure emanating from the muzzle.
target: Oculi impostoris circumspiciebantur, et ille ad terribilem pressionem a rostro provenientem evigilavit.

source: He forced a smile, handed over his revolver, and whispered, “I’ll give this to you. Can you let me go?”
target: Risum compellens, revolver suum tradidit, et sussurravit: “Hoc tibi dabo. Potesne me dimittere?”

source: Lumian’s thoughts raced as he took the revolver and nodded. “Okay.”
target: Cogitationes Lumiani adcurrerunt, dum revolver accipiebat atque annuit: “Bene.”

source: He then holstered his revolver.
target: Deinde revolver suum recondidit.

source: The ambusher maintained a humble and ingratiating smile as he turned around and walked deeper into the dark tunnel.
target: Impostor risum humilem et complacentem retinuit, dum se vertit et in cuniculum tenebrosum profundius ambulabat.

source: Suddenly, Lumian heard Termiboros’s magnificent voice.
target: Subito, Lumian vocem magnificentam Termiboros audivit.

source: “It’s best not to let him go.”
target: “Optime est ne eum dimitteris.”

source: Uh… Lumian’s eyes narrowed as he instantly sensed something was off.
target: Uh… Oculi Lumiani contrarii facti sunt, cum statim sensissent aliquid non esse rectum.

source: Why did I agree to that deal just now?
target: Cur hanc conventionem modo consensus sum?

source: Why would I let him go?
target: Cur eum dimitterem?
